summary: Rare's garden-life simulation series; use Rare Replay/backward-compatible Xbox versions for the console simulations and original DS hardware/emulation for Pocket Paradise.

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware for the enhanced official route.

primary.platform: Xbox One X / Xbox Series X/S
primary.why: The original console game is included in Rare Replay and was enhanced to native 4K on Xbox One X, making modern Xbox the best official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay or Xbox backward compatibility on Xbox One X/Series hardware; use the Windows version only for historical PC comparison.

emulation.notes: No confirmed modern route is known to exist.

primary.why: Party Animals is an Xbox 360-only racing/party spin-off by Krome Studios with no modern port documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware if available; no Rare Replay inclusion or PC port is documented.

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware for the enhanced official route.

primary.platform: Xbox One X / Xbox Series X/S
primary.why: Trouble in Paradise is the more definitive console garden game, adding co-op, new pinata types, new capture areas, and Xbox Live Vision support; Rare Replay/backward compatibility gives the best modern fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay or Xbox backward compatibility on Xbox One X/Series hardware; local/solo garden content is the main preservation target.

emulation.notes: Use touchscreen support or original DS hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native DS or high-resolution DS emulation

primary.why: Pocket Paradise was built from the ground up for DS, with stylus/two-screen controls and version-specific design changes.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo DS/3DS hardware for the intended stylus experience, or use a DS emulator with touchscreen support.
